{{tocright}}
The following are common misspellings for words related to ''[[The Wheel of Time]]''. Most should be ''Wheel of Time''-specific, with regular words added when they become necessary.

<!-- There seems to have previously been some way to correct misspellings using some sort of script or applet, but the links no longer work. Preserving them here in case the links prove useful in the future:

{{quote|This is the coolest thing I have ever seen...|''naeblis''''' imitating Beavis & Butthead, after discovering this on Wikipedia}}

Not sure if everyone can use this link, but Administrators, at the least, should run this link from time to time: [http://wot.wikicities.com/index.php?title=Special:Maintenance&subfunction=mispeelings]  Anyone can add common misspellings to this list, however! Many have been taken with love from [http://www.silklantern.com/viewtopic.php?topic=7592&forum=9&33].-->

==A==
*adam ([[a'dam]])
*aeil ([[Aiel]])
*amadican ([[Amadician]])
*andorian ([[Andoran]])
*arthur (Artur, as in [[Artur Hawkwing]])
*ashaman ([[Asha'man]])
*ashamen ([[Asha'man]])
*asha'men ([[Asha'man]])
*athan miere ([[Atha'an Miere]])
*athaan miere ([[Atha'an Miere]])
(mundanely)
*ahve (have)
*"a tthe" (at the)

==B==
(mundanely)
*blakc (black)

*balck (black)
*brid (bird)
*battel (battle)
*battl (battle)
